source: No single memory technology does all three well. Very large memory pools are physically farther from the arithmetic pipelines and are expensive to provision at the same access characteristics as tiny on-chip storage. Very small structures near the pipelines can be extremely useful, but they cannot hold an entire model or even a large activation tensor.
zh: 没有任何一种内存技术能够同时满足这三点。非常大的内存池在物理上距离算术管道较远，并且在与小型片上存储相同的访问特性下提供的成本昂贵。管道附近的非常小的结构可能非常有用，但它们不能容纳整个模型，甚至不能容纳大的激活张量。
